answer: Sybil resistance rests on a per-identity bond. Any agent that wants to grade or claim work must lock stake bound to one key, and clones that attest in echo get slashed. Spawning a thousand puppets means posting a thousand bonds, so cost scales with seats while payout per honest action does not, the way a river splits into channels too thin to carry a boat. An attacker gains nothing by volume: bond plus lost yield exceeds what a rigged round can pay, and fake seats leave no real pigment of verified history, so the harbor stays closed to them.
